channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: TN BJP demands Rahul Gandhi’s apology over ‘vote theft’ allegations in Bihar polls
item.description: The Tamil Nadu unit of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has demanded an unconditional public and parliamentary apology from Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for what it termed “baseless and damaging” allegations of vote theft and institutional bias during the Bihar Assembly elections.

item.title: Air India Group to ensure compliance with airfare cap, rolls our proactive measures
item.description: Since December 4, both carriers have proactively capped economy-class airfares on non-stop domestic flights to prevent the usual demand–supply dynamics applied by automated revenue management systems.

item.title: Elon Musk refutes reports that SpaceX is raising $800 billion
item.description: Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk on Sunday refuted reports that SpaceX is raising money worth $800 billion or NASA gives subsidies to his space company.

item.title: TVK seeks permission for Vijay’s public meeting in TN’s Erode
item.description: A representation seeking permission for a public meeting of actor-politician Vijay on December 16 at a private venue in Erode was submitted to the district administration by K.A. Sengottaiyan, Chief Coordinator of Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK).

item.title: Armed Forces Flag Day: Rajnath Singh urges people to contribute to welfare of soldiers, dependents
item.description: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh on Sunday extended greetings to the Indian Armed Forces on the occasion of their Flag Day and lauded their valour and sacrifices for the country.

item.title: Civil Aviation Minister slams Rahul Gandhi’s ‘monopoly model’ remark, says Centre always pushes for competition
item.description: Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu on Sunday criticised Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi for alleging that the Centre's policies had encouraged a "monopoly model" in the aviation industry, leading to IndiGo's widespread flight cancellations and delays.

item.title: ‘Deeply pained’: President Murmu condoles loss of lives in Goa club fire
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu on Sunday expressed deep sorrow over the massive fire that swept through a popular club in North Goa’s Arpora, killing at least 23 people and injuring several others.

item.title: 23 killed in massive midnight blaze at popular Goa club
item.description: A devastating fire at a well-known nightlife venue in North Goa’s Arpora claimed at least 23 lives late Saturday, in one of the deadliest such incidents the coastal state has witnessed in recent years.

item.title: ‘Fought hard for this one,’ writes Kuldeep Yadav after India win ODI series with SA
item.description: India's left-arm wrist spinner Kuldeep Yadav has put out a message on social media, asserting that the team has fought hard to bag the ODI series against South Africa 2-1 after winning the third and final match by nine wickets with a dominant display at the ACA-VDCa Stadium in Visakhapatnam on Saturday.

item.title: ‘Stay in your domain’: Gambhir slams ‘IPL team owner’ after ODI series win
item.description: Addressing the media after the series win, Gambhir, who highlighted the absence of skipper Shubman Gill, sidelined with a neck injury, as a key factor in India’s Test series loss, asserted that individuals outside the cricketing ecosystem should refrain from commenting on matters beyond their expertise.
